content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Source: Fever hires Blazers' Sheri Sam as assistant GM</title><link>https://www.espn.com/wnba/story/_/id/50329901/source-fever-hires-blazers-sheri-sam-assistant-gm</link><description>Sheri Sam, who was the scouting manager for the Trail Blazers, has been hired as assistant general manager of the WNBA's Fever, a source told ESPN.</description><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 20:02:38 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2023/1209/r1264312_2_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Ja Morant out at least 4 weeks with hamstring strain suffered against Grizzlies</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50329588/ja-morant-least-four-weeks-injury-vs-grizzlies</link><description>Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out at least four weeks.</description><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 19:13:25 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1030/r1738441_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>NBA buzz: Latest on trades, news, roster moves and intel</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50028196/2026-27-nba-buzz-latest-live-updates-news-intel-trades-deals</link><description>The NBA is back. The buzz never left. Bookmark this page for the latest news, rumblings and analysis from ESPN's insiders.</description><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 18:46:15 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0301/r1621468_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Sources: Thunder signing Agbaji to fill roster after Williams, Wallace injuries</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50329298/sources-thunder-signing-ochai-agbaji-fill-open-roster-spot</link><description>The Thunder are signing forward Ochai Agbaji to fill their open roster spot in the wake of major injuries suffered to starting wings Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.</description><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 18:15:00 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2016/0429/r78607_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Heat unveil updated Dwyane Wade statue after original's face was panned</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50328871/heat-unveil-updated-dwyane-wade-statue-original-face-was-panned</link><description>Dwyane Wade has a new face -- on his statue.</description><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 18:22:03 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2024/1027/r1406810_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Friday's fantasy basketball adds and bets to make in the NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/fantasy/basketball/story/_/id/50324957/fantasy-basketball-tips-nba-betting-picks-today</link><description>Andre Snellings breaks down Friday's games, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.</description><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 17:03:01 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1030/r1738596_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
